CSV TOWN CORRECTION: 'Lawngtlai' here is the district, not the town — Chawngte is a town and rural development block in Lawngtlai district, about 76 km from Lawngtlai town via the Chawngte–Lawngtlai road corridor (verify distance). No web listing for an exact building named 'Chawngte Baptist Church' was found; BCM pastor-posting records mention 'Chawngte 'L'' (Chawngte, Lawngtlai), and the Baptist Church of Mizoram's Lawngtlai Area (95 local churches per the BCM Statistical Report 2023-24) covers the region, so a BCM congregation in Chawngte is plausible but its identity is PROVISIONAL — verify locally. The geocoder also lists a 'Presbyterian Church, Chawngte 796730', a different denomination that must not be conflated with this row. Chawngte block is Chakma-majority (2011: 41,715 Buddhist vs 2,735 Christian), and the BCM's Chakma Baptist Church association works among the Chakma people.

town_description: Chawngte is a town and rural development block in Lawngtlai district, Mizoram, in the western, Chakma-majority part of the district near the Bangladesh border. Per the 2011 census the block is majority Buddhist (41,715) with a Christian minority (2,735); the Baptist Church of Mizoram (including its Chakma Baptist Church association) is one of the Christian denominations present.
